description: NaBa₄(BN₂)₃ crystallizes in the cubic Im̅3m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form NaN₆ octahedra that share faces with eight equivalent BaN₆ octahedra. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.64 Å. Ba is bonded to six equivalent N atoms to form distorted BaN₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BaN₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent BaN₆ octahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaN₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 26°. All Ba-N bond lengths are 2.90 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent N atoms. Both B-N bond lengths are 1.36 Å. N is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four equivalent Ba, and one B atom.
